issues.title: Several crashes fixed — please update to p93
issues.description:
Multiple stability issues were detected in your version and have been resolved in p93:

• Crash when navigating via the + menu (omnibar null-route, OBTAINIUMPLUS-J)
• Crash in error reporting with a stale UI context (OBTAINIUMPLUS-9 / -F)
• Type error: BehaviorSettingsProvider mismatch on Settings page (OBTAINIUMPLUS-B / -G)
• Null crash on settings page init (OBTAINIUMPLUS-K)

These appear in crash analytics. Updating takes ~30 seconds via the Updates tab.

issues.title: Startup Crash: APKDir Not Initialized
issues.description: A 'LateInitializationError' occurs during startup when the app attempts to access the APK directory before it has been fully initialized. This can prevent the app from opening.

issues.title: Type Error: BehaviorSettingsProvider Mismatch
issues.description: A 'TypeError' occurs where BehaviorSettingsProvider is not recognized as a subtype of SettingsProvider. This typically happens when navigating to the settings page or during provider initialization.

issues.title: Range Error: Invalid List Index
issues.description: A 'RangeError' occurs when accessing list elements, particularly during category reordering or rapid UI updates. This results in the app freezing or crashing to the error screen.

issues.title: Null Check Crash: MultiApp Error Reporting
issues.description: A crash occurs when reporting errors for multiple apps simultaneously due to an unexpected null value in the error handling logic.
